value.rationale: A natural parameter chamber of a published hidden-attractor map is proved globally free of all bounded dynamics, not just fixed points or low-period cycles. The exact inclusive critical boundary and quantified spatial escape rate distinguish the result from cheap negative tests. The gap to the independent first two-cycle threshold is exactly 1/5210 on the source numerical slice, demonstrating a near-sharp structural delimitation without overclaiming recurrence past the barrier.
